|lore=Jedi Master currently not on the Council. Although he serves the Council well, there have been times when he has defied their wishes to pursue a path he believes is right.

|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/masterquigon.html</ref>

The second Qui-Gon card to hit the game is also a powerful character for the Light Side. He has the usual high stats you would expect from a Jedi Master who still actively serves the Old Republic. He's able to "teleport" by returning to your hand and then be available to be deployed elsewhere the next turn (or even deploy a different version of him instead). Using 4 Force is expensive but it can not be canceled by [[Sense]] or blocked by anything else normally.

The other good part about Qui-Gon is that he is immune to [[You Are Beaten]], ensuring that he can not be excluded from a battle that way. You can count on him to be there to protect other characters with him, just like the true guardian he is.
